title: Old Synagogue (Essen)
scope: The principal standing Old Synagogue in Essen, with the Steeler Tor entrance, drum and main dome, curved lateral galleries, flanking towers, and the rear wall. Roofs follow the city’s documented restoration.
limitations: Represents the permanent restored form documented by the city. Temporary construction scaffolding, the removed outer forecourt arcade, the separate rabbi’s house, and interior exhibits are outside the building model.
Masses, openings and architectural hierarchy follow the original elevations and native surveyed outline. Individual ashlar joints and fine tracery are representative.
